source: maplestory.io (GMS 270) — skillbook API + raw WZ API; class-specific 5th job skill list cross-checked against maplestorywiki.net
notes: 1st-job skills pulled from skillbook job 4200 on 2026-11-16 (11 skills); earlier note claiming they were absent from GMS 270 was wrong — the job 4200 book exists.

skills.name: Blessing of the Five Elements
skills.description: Kanna stays strong and unwavering as the power of the elements flows through both body and mind.

skills.name: Hand of Fate
skills.description: By the time they reached adulthood, Kanna understood instinctively that they were fated to become a Spirit Walker.

skills.name: Elementalism
skills.description:
Learn to read the ever-changing flow of spirits during battle, and borrow a small portion of their power to deal more damage to enemies.
Preparations will be complete after activating attack skills a set number of times. Activating an attack skill once preparations are complete will temporarily grant you the Elementalism effect.

skills.name: Return of the Five Planets
skills.description: Returns you to Momijigaoka.

skills.name: Crimson Covenant
skills.description:
Use this holy relic to summon the Oni Shikigami. The greater your understanding of the relic, the closer the Shikigami comes to its full power.
Grants Oni the Blessing of Recovery trait.

skills.name: Clear Mind
skills.description: Keep a level head, no matter the chaos around you.

skills.name: Eternal Bonds
skills.description: While you are protected by the bonds of friendship, you have nothing to fear.

skills.name: Spiritual Enlightenment
skills.description: Bring your spiritual energy into harmony to reach the greatest heights.

skills.name: Soul-Shatter Talisman: Scores
skills.description: Attack enemies by flinging exorcism talismans in front of you.

skills.name: Commune
skills.description:
Attempt to commune with a Shikigami using mana.
Depending on your affinity with the Shikigami, displays a short conversation. Increase affinity by using skills or communing with the Shikigami.
Can only be used in town.

skills.name: Leap Talisman
skills.description: Use a talisman to teleport a set distance. If used in town without pressing a directional key, teleports to a random location.

skills.name: Summon Oni
skills.description:
Summon the Oni Shikigami.
Oni automatically tracks enemies within range and attacks them with her giant club. She uses the skills she knows at will.
Oni is not affected by attack reflection, cooldown resets, or Summon Duration increases.
Resonance Effect Simplification: Right-click.

skills.name: Leaping Strike
skills.description:
[Spirit Walker Skill]
Use your power as a Spirit Walker to attack enemies in front of you.

skills.name: Crimson Covenant II
skills.description:
Use this holy relic to summon the Oni Shikigami. The greater your understanding of the relic, the closer Oni comes to her full power.
With increased understanding, Oni's Celestial Strike and Leaping Strike are enhanced.
Grants Oni Crimson Flame.

skills.name: Ayanokouji Bloodline
skills.description: As a member of the Ayanokouji family, you have always had an innate talent for analyzing situations, both mundane and spiritual.

skills.name: Crimson Flame
skills.description: Increases Normal Enemy Damage for Kanna and all Shikigami.

skills.name: Soul-Shatter Talisman: Icon
skills.description: Attack enemies by flinging exorcism talismans in front of you.

skills.name: Evil's End Talisman
skills.description: Unfold talismans around you to attack nearby enemies.

skills.name: [Order] Spinning Strike
skills.description:
Can be used if Oni is summoned. Order Oni to use Spinning Strike.
When this skill is activated with the down arrow key, directs Oni to use the skill in front of you.

skills.name: [Order] Spinning Strike
skills.description: Brandish your fan in such a way that it resembles a peacock with its tailfeathers spread wide, increasing the attack speed of the fan by 2 levels.

skills.name: Peacock's Plumage
skills.description: Unfold a beautiful fan to direct the flow of battle. Temporarily increases the your Attack Speed.

skills.name: [Order] Spinning Strike
skills.description:

skills.name: Berserk
skills.description: Oni Final Damage increases per stack.

With increased understanding, Oni's Celestial Strike and Leaping Strike are enhanced.
Grants Oni the Berserk trait and the Explosive Soul skill.

skills.name: Obsidian Feather
skills.description:
Use this holy relic to summon the Tengu Shikigami. The greater your understanding of the relic, the closer Tengu comes to her full power.
Grants Tengu the Keen Hunter trait.

skills.name: Spirit Path
skills.description: Hone your skills as a Spirit Walker, enhancing your power to subdue unclean beings.

skills.name: Unshakeable Faith
skills.description: Become immovable with the bulwark of faith.

skills.name: Soul-Shatter Talisman: Spirit

skills.name: Summon Tengu
skills.description:
Summon the Tengu Shikigami.
Tengu automatically tracks and attacks enemies in a wide range. She uses the skills she knows at will.
Tengu is not affected by attack reflection, cooldown resets, or Summon Duration increases.
Resonance Effect Simplification: Right-click.

skills.name: Shikigami Charm
skills.description:
Use your powers as a Spirit Walker to focus energy beneath you, transforming mana into a great gust of air which lifts you high into the air.
 After using Shikigami Charm, Leap Talisman can be used once while in the air, even if there is no platform.

skills.name: Barrier: Curse Ward
skills.description:
Use a pre-prepared Safety Charm to create a small barrier that protects you from all harm.
The barrier is temporary, and grants invincibility while it is active.

skills.name: [Order] Standby
skills.description:
Call all your Shikigami and command them to wait until further notice.
Can be toggled On/Off
Using Order or Spirit skills will be toggled Off by default.
Effect Simplification: Right-click.

skills.name: Ivory Fang
skills.description:
Use this holy relic to summon the Orochi Shikigami. The greater your understanding of the relic, the closer the Shikigami comes to its full power.
Grants Orochi the Lofty View and Overwhelming Force traits.

skills.name: Obsidian Feather II
skills.description:
Use this holy relic to summon the Tengu Shikigami. The greater your understanding of the relic, the closer Tengu comes to her full power.
With increased understanding, Tengu's Piercing Shot is enhanced.
Grants Tengu the Steady Aim trait and Rain of Darkness skill.

skills.name: Crimson Covenant IV
skills.description:
Use this holy relic to summon the Oni Shikigami. The greater your understanding of the relic, the closer Oni comes to her full power.
With increased understanding, Oni's Celestial Strike, Leaping Strike, and Explosive Soul are enhanced.
Grants Oni the Strongarm trait.

skills.name: Shikigami Master
skills.description: Your Shikigami have absolute trust in you, enhancing their battle efficiency and granting them the ability to Resonate.

skills.name: Kasen
skills.description: Increase mastery, damage, and attack speed by becoming one with the Spirit Walker Fan.

skills.name: Rain of Darkness

skills.name: Barrier: Spirit Chains
skills.description:
Use a barrier-creating talisman to hinder the enemy's movements.
Barrier: Spirit Chains targets the enemy with the highest Max HP within range.
Foes hit cannot be immobilized again for 90 sec by Barrier: Sealing Spirit Chains or other skills.
Not affected by cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Heart-Wreck Talisman
skills.description:
Throw talismans across a wide area, filling it with an energy that harms your enemies.
Applies a temporary debuff to enemies hit by the attack that increases their damage taken from Shikigami.

skills.name: Summon Orochi
skills.description:
Summon the Orochi Shikigami.
Orochi automatically tracks enemies within range and attacks with chained scythes. She uses the skills she knows at will.
Orochi is not affected by attack reflection, cooldown resets, or Summon Duration increases.
Resonance Effect Simplification: Right-click.

skills.name: Dance of Poison
skills.description:
[Spirit Walker Skill]
Throw a charm imbued with the power to seal demons at the enemies before you, temporarily turning them to stone and stunning them in place.

skills.name: Shadow Cleave
skills.description:
[Barrier]
Use your power as a Spirit Walker to create a Bellflower Barrier, strengthening yourself and your party members. Inside the Bellflower Barrier, Damage is increased by ndieDamR% and Boss Damage is increased by dR%.
When used on a Mana Vein, the barrier will absorb the vein's energy to enhance the barrier, as well as restore additional Mana for yourself while you stand within it.

skills.name: Akatsuki Warrior
skills.description: Your Akatsuki training increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Sengoku Warrior emblem appear.

skills.name: Akatsuki Will
skills.description: Hone your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through.

skills.name: Call of Unity
skills.description:
Haku unleashes the power of Hakumenkonmou for a moment and shares it with the Shikigami.
You receive 1 stack of Call of Unity per summoned Shikigami. Each stack increases Critical Rate and Damage.
(Stacks up to 3 times.)
Not affected by cooldown reset effects.

Increases your attack skills by overloading the mana flowing through you.

skills.name: [Spirit] Hakumenkonmou Juubi
skills.description:
The strength of your bond with Haku temporarily awakens her as a transcendental spirit.
Shikigami summon duration doesn't decrease during her awakening, and Haku makes supporting attacks at set intervals.
Haku's final blow is activated when the skill key is pressed again while the skill is active, or when its duration ends.

skills.name: [Spirit] Unleash the Radiant Flame
skills.description: Unleash a portion of Oni's power, igniting a spark of madness and allowing her to go berserk. On your order, she will light the radiant flame.

skills.name: Ethereal Form

skills.name: [Spirit] Unleash Black-Winged Destruction
